news_policy.actionable_threshold: changes architecture, reliability, agent configuration, testing, security, context engineering, model routing, cost, or developer workflow

branch_policy.retirement_truth_boundary: retirement requires provider-read-back UNIQUE_CONTRIBUTION=0 across every unique source, event, edge, contradiction, provenance, mechanism, unresolved dependency, receipt, and authority-domain fact, plus verified lineage/source pointers; this proof boundary does not create an additional per-retirement approval requirement where controlling Operator instructions already govern; PR closure, newer main, patch similarity, merge completion, or prior retirement language are not retirement authority; remote-ref deletion is not a retirement action and is forbidden in the automated retirement lifecycle

fork_policy.upstream_tracking_rule: fast-forward only from source/upstream; never place GlacierEQ custom commits on this line
fork_policy.overlay_rule: GlacierEQ changes are composed on top of refreshed upstream state rather than copied through or substituted for source internals
fork_policy.integration_rule: refresh upstream first, synthesize custom delta on current ancestry, verify, then promote

execution_harness_policy.purpose: adaptive worker execution, claim-discipline gating, provider-width control, per-turn scoring, and immutable worker proof

mutation_gates.branch_deletion: forbidden as an automated retirement action; preserve the ref or another durable source pointer so lineage remains addressable
